description: This file is a CMake module script defining a function to compile AIDL files during build time. It provides functionality to generate source code from AIDL files with configurable options such as language, include directories, and target output directory.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: Defines a CMake function to compile AIDL files into source code, supporting configurable options like language, include directories, and output directory.
